acceptance.description: The final physical actuator is the controller's tracked actuator across trip, interlock, C1 backwash/permissive entry and release for both loops: protective ownership is decided before normal PI integration, the integral is held from the first protected scan, the actual stopped value is committed into actuator tracking, the release is preloaded from that actual value and every ordinary reopening/re-starting step obeys the declared valve 10 pp/s and pump 5 pp/s slew (protective stopping alone may bypass slew); requested-vs-applied provenance is preserved

Energy is integrated from the realized operating point of the ACHIEVED pumped throughput of each tick (actual speed + frozen pump/system laws), with head and motor feasibility enforced on the realized point, OFF distinguished from powered-zero-flow/insufficient-head, an explicitly declared idle-loss rule and no invented useful hydraulic power; an independent recomputation from the physical transfer records reproduces the ledger across startup, zero available water, full receiver and narrowed downstream capacity, and a rated/capacity-flow substitution fails
Regression: 16 admitted scopes on deterministic global 1-second windows in one attempt-bound session with exactly two active C2 PI loops and the deferred loops unavailable
Regression: the full-run independent water identity still closes from tick zero with no created water and no compensation term
Regression: flow limiting and reservation semantics are unchanged (capacity tokens, no double count, queue bound, no hidden loss or deadlock)
Regression: the two PIs drive the real actuators with feasible SP tracking, disturbance rejection, saturation with a reason and recovery inside one ongoing attempt
Regression: pump envelope feasibility, OFF exactly zero flow and zero energy, unit-explicit energy and unmodelled energy declared unavailable - now evaluated on REALIZED operating points
Regression: physical-envelope mutations still fail the oracle or fail safely
Regression: canonical X3 1 s default, X2-60s zero-C2 and G21 compatibility, deterministic reset/attempt/replay, no protected path changed
